Every place, by district.

## Tremé

| Place | Boss | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Lagniappe Social Aid & Pleasure Club (`club`) | — | Home base. Folding chairs, a trophy wall, a coffee urn older than you, and the quest board nobody's allowed to touch but Mama Roux. |
| Mama Roux's Kitchen (`kitchen`) | — | Six stools, one pot, and the best cook in the Sixth Ward. |
| Ti-Jacques' Pawn & Horn (`pawn`) | — | Horns in the window, suits in the back, and a man who can fix anything that makes a sound. |
| Congo Square (`congo`) | Captain Hush | Sacred ground, where the drums never stopped. Metronome put a fence around it. The fence hums. |

| Place | Boss | Description |
